name: ai-agents-skills
description: Skills and optional hooks for Cursor Agent CLI/IDE: Kanban boards, Git safety, review and verification, security, deployment, monitoring, research, Telegram notifications and reviewed skill import. Skills are named <area>-<object>-<goal>; only a small always-on set is described to the model and the rest are found through agent-skill-find. The scheduled-run prototype is Claude-specific.
